case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests commonly praised the hotel's central, convenient location, friendly and helpful staff, and the quality and variety of the breakfast; several also valued the rooftop pool/bar, cleanliness and comfortable beds. Some reviewers reported smaller or slightly worn rooms. Isolated operational issues cited included an occasionally failing breakfast coffee machine, paid billiards not disclosed, a separately charged in‑room safe, faulty lift buttons and one instance of incorrect picnic pickup information.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.area: Spa and pool (limited pool space / capacity)
priorities.recommendation: Assess rooftop pool capacity and guest expectations.

Review how ancillary fees are presented on the hotel website, OTAs, confirmations, and at check-in.
